entities.summary: Allameh Mohammad-Taqi Ja'fari was an Iranian scholar, philosopher, intellectual, and islamic theologist. Ja'fari was a Shia philosopher. He was considered an expert in history, metaphysics, philosophy, literature, mysticism, jurisprudence, and philosophy of science.
